name: ArticleCard
description: Linked article or resource card with media, eyebrow, title, summary and metadata.
designIntent: Content hubs repeat the same article tile. ArticleCard owns the image aspect, title hierarchy, excerpt clamp and metadata row so blog, resource and LOI pages do not each invent a card.

props.name: meta
props.description: Date, read time, author or other metadata.

props.name: variant
props.description: Standard card or a denser compact card.

examples.title: Resource card
examples.code: } />
examples.description: A linked article tile for a resource grid.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest controls in the card
antiPatterns.explanation: The whole card is one link. Put save, share or menu actions outside the card or redesign the card as a non-link panel.

accessibility.implementation: The card is one link containing the title, summary and metadata
accessibility.userRequirements: Use a descriptive title so the link name is meaningful
Use alt="" for decorative covers or a meaningful alt for informative images

compositionRules.relationship: Place cards in a responsive Grid
